The Generic Regulation line is comprised of the following map layer components:


• Crest of slope (including 15 metre allowance)
• Estimated floodplain (including 15 metre allowance)
• Engineered floodplain mapping (including 15 metre allowance)
• Lake Ontario shoreline (including 15 metre allowance)
• Drainage network (including 15 metre allowance)
• Meander belt (including 15 metre allowance)
• Slope hazard (including 15 metre allowance)
• Wetlands (including 30 metre allowance)
 

This layer is consistent with the requirements of Ontario Regulation 41/24: Prohibited Activities, Exemptions and Permits under the Conservation Authorities Act.The text of the Regulation takes precedence over the Regulation Limit mapping. Some regulated features may not appear on Regulation Limit mapping. For more information, please contact planning@cvc.ca.
